Second slug /schreiber-dynamix-dairies-pvt-ltd (address E-94, MIDC, Bhigwan Road, Baramati, Pune, Maharashtra) shows 5 further dated export rows to Bangladesh: "2022-07-04 | SCHREIBER DYNAMIX DAIRIES PVT LTD | TO THE ORDER OF STANDARD CHARTERED BANK, SHREDDED MOZZARELLA CHEESE, FROZEN PIZZA TOPPING CHEESE | Nhava Sheva, India | BDCGP, Bangladesh | 190007.0 | BOM3C1B2BH00" plus BOM3C7129300 (2022-06-13), BOM2C1B2BB00 (2022-03-20), BOM214323300 (2021-03-05), BOM917420900 (2021-01-08). Source counter vs rows seen: page claims 1227 total shipments / 22 trading partners / 25 ports; only 5 row-level records were visible on the free view (plus 5 on the second slug) — the 1227 figure is the site's aggregate counter, not independently verified.
domestic_evidence: No public GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic/export split could be retrieved: web_search returned no results (searx connection refused) and the financial-data pages attempted (tofler.in, zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com) returned 404/403 or no company financials. Domestic supply is therefore not confirmed and not denied — null, not public in the sources reachable.
note: Real, dated export shipments are confirmed by customs/B-L records, not by website claims: rennet casein (HS 35011000) to the Philippines, skimmed milk powder (HS 04021010) to New Zealand and string cheese (HS 04061010) to Sri Lanka in Feb 2026, plus mozzarella/pizza-topping cheese (HS 190007) to Bangladesh 2021–2022. Declared HS 040410 (whey/modified milk powder) does not match the observed shipment HS codes (04021010, 04061010, 35011000, 190007) — per project rules this is not a rejection ground; the actual HS codes should be corrected to the observed ones and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected.
